title: PROPOSED reused criteria list
description: Design-only list transcribed from the DK-500d-1 delivers_to contract (docs/acceptance-criteria/decision-kernel/DK-500-reusable-decision-criteria/DK-500d-1.yaml): each published category that fits the decision is offered as one proposed criterion linked to its category. DK-500d-1 names left_out_count beside this list but defines no enclosing payload, so that count is not part of this schema. No kernel step, payload or validator implements this list yet; it is not a kernel Criterion, which forbids extra fields such as category_id.

category_id.description: the published CriterionCategory.id this criterion is reused from

criterion_id.description: the most common member criterion id (ties in lexical order), made unique within the decision

priority.description: the majority priority among the category's member criteria, falling back to the decision record schema default on a tie

kind.description: the majority kind among the category's member criteria, falling back to the decision record schema default on a tie

proposal_status.description: always proposed: a reused criterion reaches the approval gate as a proposal, never as approved

reuse.description: reuse-link kind named in DK-500d-1; the reuse step emits unedited
